bio.text: Jesse Kiehl, a Democrat, has served in the Alaska Senate since 2019, representing District B, according to the Alaska Legislature.
His legislative biography says Kiehl was born and raised in Anchorage and graduated from Whitman College.

Before the Senate he worked as a legislative staffer for Southeast Alaska state senators for eighteen years and served more than seven years on the Juneau Assembly, including as chair of its finance committee.
